_why: P3024b/P3024c: exact Zigbee pairing couples (manufacturerName x productId, cartesian per driver, exact case) of the LAST Athom Test package of THIS app (com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee.stable). scripts/maintenance/compact-zigbee-identifiers.cjs pins every couple here so a publish budget cut can never drop a couple users could already pair; prepare-publish fails if one would disappear. Rebuilt locally from the git sha the CI checked out (homey app build + prepare-publish, env 14000/1500/2); the rebuilt identifier matrix matches the CI log exactly. Update with scripts/maintenance/build-publish-baseline.cjs --merge when a newer build reaches Test. sources[] lists every payload merged in (additive: --merge never removes a couple). restored[] holds the EXACT couples the previous Test package #392 (5.12.502, sha 5ab49f83dd) shipped and #393 lost (pinned exactly, never merged into drivers m x p so no cross couple is invented); notRestored[] lists the #392 couples deliberately not restored (pid RC-EF-3.0 moved off button_emergency_sos by the curated P2974 wrong-class fix). exemptions[] = baseline couples a human-reviewed curated removal (config/architecture/curated-couple-removals.json) took out of the source.
